title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 0.1 Test 4
summary: This is an unsigned test build of the portable green Mouse Without Borders fork. Download `MouseWithoutBorders.exe` from Assets and use this same release on every computer.
changes: Adds a Create desktop shortcut option to installation, checked by default.
Adds a Portable tab in Settings so a configured portable copy can be installed later.
Preserves the existing security key, machine layout, and options when moving from portable to installed mode.
Waits for the portable process to exit before removing its old prefs and starting the installed EXE.
Disables the legacy timed key-expiration and auto-generated-key nags and caps local diagnostic-log growth.
Renames public-facing documentation and release text from Standalone to Portable and adds a detailed extraction history.
testing: With no prefs file, choose Install for me and confirm the desktop-shortcut checkbox starts checked; test both checked and unchecked choices.
Choose Run portable here, configure a key/layout/options, then use Settings > Portable > Install this portable copy and confirm the installed copy retains all of them.
Confirm the old portable prefs is removed only after restart, while the original downloaded EXE remains untouched.
Test Start with Windows, the Start Menu shortcut, the desktop shortcut, and self-uninstall from the tray menu.
Use a manually typed key for more than one minute and confirm Settings does not reopen, sockets are not closed, and no generation/expiry warning appears.
Use this same Test 4 EXE on both computers and test mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, reconnect, firewall prompting, and sleep/wake.
